item.title: Safety Precautions for Artists: Protect Your Art, Health, and Career
item.description: Staying safe is something we think about more often in our personal lives than it is with our art. But here are a few tips to help you protect your art, health and career from Professional Artist columnist Renee Philips.

item.title: Self-care and Wellness for Artists - Professional Artist Magazine
item.description: In the inside story selection for the June/July 2018 issue of Professional Artist, contributor Rebecca Coleman shares with us her tips on self-care and wellness as a full-time artist.

item.title: Improve Your Attention to Details to Enhance Art Career Success - Professional Artist Magazine
item.description: Renee Phillips, The Artreprenuer Coach and Professional Artist contributor outlines the easy ways artists can be successful by paying special attention to details in both art and business.

item.title: The Power of Art in Healing - Professional Artist Magazine
item.description: Professional Artist contributor Ora Sorensen examines the healing powers art can have to those in hospitals after receiving a kind email from a woman whose husband benefitted from Sorensen's art during his time in the hospital.

item.title: Use Audience Feedback to Make Better Art - Professional Artist Magazine
item.description: Gigi Rosenberg, author, artist coach and editor of Professional Artist, shares her advice on how to use the audience's feedback at your shows to improve your art.

item.title: Message for Your Younger Self - Professional Artist Magazine
item.description: Professional Artist editor and contributor Gigi Rosenburg reflects on a time where her career aspirations were dashed, and what she would tell her younger self if she was able to go back in time.

item.title: Stop Procrastinating Now! - Professional Artist Magazine
item.description: Professional Artist contributor and Artrepreneur Coach Renee Phillips outlines the best way to unlearn the practice of procrastination.

item.title: How Art Careers Happen - Professional Artist Magazine
item.description: Professional Artist contributor Mary Edwards examines the careers of three different artists, all who had different journeys to end at the successes they've accomplished. She shows there is truly no one way to have a successful career as an artist.
